# Which student loan repayment plan costs you the least?

> Free student loan calculator: compare the new Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP), Income-Based Repayment (IBR) and the tiered Standard plan. Monthly payment, total paid, amount forgiven, tax on forgiveness and a PSLF mode. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
